description: Estimate the USD cost of Claude API calls from token counts. Handles prompt caching (cache writes and reads), the Batch API 50% discount and long-prompt pricing. Returns cost per request and in total.

cache_read_tokens.description: Tokens read from the prompt cache per request

cache_write_1h_tokens.description: Tokens written to the 1-hour prompt cache per request

cache_write_5m_tokens.description: Tokens written to the 5-minute prompt cache per request

model.description: Model id, e.g. claude-fable-5-2, claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-5-5

output_tokens.description: Output tokens per request (includes thinking tokens)

name: estimate_claude_cost
title: Estimate Claude API cost
